details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm{TS}_{\max}^p(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: Every coordinate projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$ has at most $|\mathcal H|$ distinct concepts. For a projected target, choose one distinguishing coordinate against each other projected concept; their union is a teaching set of size at most $|\mathcal H|-1$. Taking the defining maximum over targets and projections proves the bound.
name: Size / Maximum Projected Teaching Set Size
